visual: Tender rhizomatous begonia grown primarily for its striking foliage, with asymmetrical heart-shaped leaves marked in silvery green, dark green and reddish tones and contrasting red undersides.
soilWarning: No waterlogging, no harsh sun, never dry
prune: Remove dead or damaged leaves and stems as required; pinch growing tips to maintain a compact shape.
toxicity: Harmful if eaten; sap may irritate the skin.
hardinessNote: Tender tropical plant; grow indoors or under heated protection in the UK.
resilience: Good indoor foliage plant when humidity, warmth and consistent moisture are maintained.
uses: Houseplant, terrarium, conservatory and heated greenhouse.
